The '''Shipping Facility''' was a shipping terminal located in the [[Minboosa District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was associated to [[Vobbara Yusinduu]]'s [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Refining Factory]]. The Shipping Facility was [[Raid on the Minboosa District|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:WBM" />
